title: Receipts are append-only
body: No receipt row is ever updated or deleted once written.
breaks_if: any code path UPDATEs or DELETEs a receipt: the trigger aborts the statement

title: Only a receipt moves touched_at
body: Editing a node is not progress: touched_at changes only when a receipt is added.
breaks_if: a new write path sets touched_at directly, and stale work looks fresh to the lint

title: A dropped node carries its reason
body: A node in state dropped always has why_dropped.
breaks_if: a write sets state=dropped without why_dropped: the CHECK constraint rejects it

title: An old binary never opens a newer store
body: A coordlite whose SCHEMA_VERSION is below the store's user_version refuses to open it, before touching anything.
breaks_if: the version check is removed or SCHEMA_VERSION is not bumped with a breaking change, and an old binary fails on a CHECK constraint mid-session

title: A model cannot hold the master hostage
body: If the master is asked for a brief and two turns end without brief_write, the plugin hands off anyway with the old brief.
breaks_if: the turn counter is removed: a model that ignores the HANDOFF prompt keeps the session growing until it fails

title: A handoff cannot loop
body: If the context is still over the threshold on the first step after a handoff, handoffs are disabled for that session, until the next compaction resets the plugin's state.
breaks_if: the boot packet alone exceeds the threshold and handoffs fire on every step

title: Journal entries are append-only
body: A journal entry's time, session, author, kind and body never change and it is never deleted; its compiled markers are set later. (The agent and tokens columns are not protected.)
breaks_if: something rewrites an entry: the trigger aborts it

title: A proposal never becomes a fact
body: What a session suggested but did not decide becomes a PROPOSED decision with an owner, never a sentence in a concept body.
breaks_if: the compiling model reads 'I'd opt for X' as 'X is used' and writes it into a concept body (seen live with a free model)

title: The quiz is closed book
body: The quiz session never reads a quiz node's content or its answer key before the human has answered; questions are prepared by a background subagent.
breaks_if: the quiz agent calls node_get or learn_key early, and the answer is on the human's screen

title: Learner reviews are append-only
body: No answer in the review log is ever updated or deleted.
breaks_if: a code path rewrites or deletes a review: the trigger aborts it
